label: day246
title_zh: 各种各样的人，各种各样的事

lines.en: label day246:
scene hallnoonwinter
I emerge from the teacher’s lounge and make my way over to the cafeteria, hoping to bump into Ami or Ayane so I can ask them for some lunch money.
lines.zh: 我从教师休息室出来，往食堂走去，希望能碰上 Ami 或 Ayane，好跟她们要点午饭钱。

lines.en: Do I have my own money? Yes. Of course I do.
lines.zh: 我自己有钱吗？有。当然有。

lines.en: I am a functioning adult.
lines.zh: 我是个能正常运转的成年人。

lines.en: But if I’m able to save a few hundred yen every here and there, I can even start cancelling out the Chosokabes' phone bill- a thing I often forget I’m even paying for.
lines.zh: 但如果我这儿省几百日元、那儿省几百日元，说不定就能抵掉 Chosokabe 家的电话费——那笔钱我经常忘了自己还在付。

lines.en: Unfortunately, it doesn’t look like anyone I know is around, so I’m just going to have to figure out something when I get to the-
lines.zh: 不巧的是，看上去一个认识的人都不在，所以我只能等到了——再想办法了。

lines.en: : Oh! Good timing!
lines.zh: : 哦！来得早不如来得巧！

lines.en: : Sensei! Over here! Look behind you!
lines.zh: : Sensei！这边！看您身后！

lines.en: scene utawakana1
: Please explain to me why this girl is ruining the only thirty minutes I have to myself in this god-forsaken place.
lines.zh: : 请给我解释一下，为什么这个女生要毁掉我在这个被神遗弃的地方仅有的三十分钟独处时间。

lines.en: : I wish I had an answer for you.
lines.zh: : 我也希望能给你个答案。

lines.en: : So, Sensei, it’s been a couple days and Io still isn’t in our class yet, so I figured I might as well start reaching out on your behalf.
lines.zh: : 那么，Sensei，都过好几天了 Io 还没进我们班，所以我想干脆由我来替您出面催一催。

lines.en: : You know Ms. Watabe, right?
lines.zh: : 您认识 Watabe 老师吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, we have a suicide pact together.
lines.zh: : 认识，我们之间有张自杀契约。

lines.en: : Awesome.
lines.zh: : 太棒了。

lines.en: : That’s a closer bond than I was expecting, so why don’t we start this transaction up right now? Do either of you two have a pen?
lines.zh: : 这关系比我预想的还亲近，那我们干脆现在就开始这笔交易吧？你们俩谁有笔吗？

lines.en: : I have no pen. I will sign in my blood.
lines.zh: : 我没有笔。我会用血签字。

lines.en: scene utawakana2
: Uhh...do you need someone to talk to, Ms. Watabe?
lines.zh: : 呃……您需要找人聊聊吗，Watabe 老师？

lines.en: : I need everyone to go away.
lines.zh: : 我需要所有人都消失。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure she was joking, Uta. Contrary to how she looks, Ms. Watabe is a ball of sunshine just waiting to share her joy with the world.
lines.zh: : 我很确定她是在开玩笑，Uta。跟外表相反，Watabe 老师其实是一团等着把快乐分享给全世界的阳光。

lines.en: scene utawakana3
: Ugh...what’s even the point of this?
lines.zh: : 呃……这到底有什么意义？

lines.en: : I already told you that you can have anyone you want.
lines.zh: : 我说过了，你想要谁都可以。

lines.en: : Just fill out the paperwork...inform the principal...and the job is done.
lines.zh: : 填好文件……通知校长……事情就办完了。

lines.en: : Now, begone. I want to get back to my food.
lines.zh: : 现在，滚吧。我要继续吃我的饭。

lines.en: : What are you eating, if you don’t mind me asking?
lines.zh: : 介意我问一句您在吃什么吗？

lines.en: : Boiled newts? Lizard eggs?
lines.zh: : 水煮蝾螈？蜥蜴蛋？

lines.en: : A convenience store bento, you single-minded, unobservant bastard.
lines.zh: : 便利店便当，你这个一根筋、没眼力见的混蛋。

lines.en: : Our desks are literally right next to each other in the lounge. I eat the same thing every single day.
lines.zh: : 休息室里我们的桌子就紧挨着。我每天都吃同样的东西。

lines.en: : It’s becoming stranger and stranger that we’ve never talked until recently.
lines.zh: : 我们直到最近才说过话，这件事越来越奇怪了。

lines.en: scene utawakana4
: So, just to make sure I’m on the same page as you two, all that needs to be done is a little paperwork?
lines.zh: : 那么，我想确认一下我跟你们俩想法一致，需要做的就只是填点文件？

lines.en: : And obtaining the principal’s approval, yes. He needs to sign off on things like that.
lines.zh: : 还有拿到校长的批准，对。这种事他得签字。

lines.en: : Talk to Miyamura. She’ll know how to handle it.
lines.zh: : 去找 Miyamura。她知道该怎么弄。

lines.en: : That’s the other girl with glasses in the class, right? I can do that. We can bond over our poor vision.
lines.zh: : 就是班上另一个戴眼镜的女生吧？这个我能办。我们可以靠视力差结成同盟。

lines.en: : Thank you for confirming that those are not just cosmetic. I’d been wondering that since the other day.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你确认那副眼镜不只是装饰。我从前几天就开始好奇了。

lines.en: scene utawakana5
: You thought I was wearing these for the sake of being cute?! They make my eyes like a zillion times bigger!
lines.zh: : 您以为我是为了可爱才戴眼镜的？！它让我的眼睛大了一亿倍好吗！

lines.en: : Do you have an eye fetish, Sensei?!
lines.zh: : 您有恋眼癖吗，Sensei？！

lines.en: : That’s so weird! What other kind of weird stuff are you into?!
lines.zh: : 太变态了！您还喜欢什么别的变态东西？！

lines.en: : Close your ears, Ms. Watabe! I have no idea what this guy is going to say next!
lines.zh: : 捂住耳朵，Watabe 老师！我不知道这个人接下来说得出什么话！

lines.en: : The way you run your class worries me more and more every day.
lines.zh: : 你管班的方式一天比一天让我担心。

lines.en: : I’ve found it’s best to just let it run itself.
lines.zh: : 我发现最好的办法就是让它自己运转。

lines.en: : I can tell how well it’s working from how long this girl has been holding onto the sleeve of my dress.
lines.zh: : 从这个女生抓着我裙子袖子多久，就能看出成效有多「好」了。

lines.en: : Maybe she just really likes the dress? I think it looks great on you.
lines.zh: : 也许她只是很喜欢这条裙子？我觉得您穿很好看。

lines.en: : I agree. It matches the color of my soul.
lines.zh: : 我同意。它和我灵魂的颜色很配。

lines.en: scene utawakana6
: Ahh! Stop flirting with each other and just get Io into the class already! She’s gonna die in Ms. Watabe’s room at this rate!
lines.zh: : 啊啊！别再互相调情了，赶紧把 Io 弄进我们班吧！再这样下去她要死在 Watabe 老师的教室里了！

lines.en: : So will I, most likely.
lines.zh: : 大概我也会死在那儿。

lines.en: : Destined to wander the halls of the[school] as a ghost and have first-years tell tales of the Wailing Wakana.
lines.zh: : 命中注定要化作幽灵在这所[school]的走廊里游荡，让一年级新生传颂「哭泣的 Wakana」的传说。

lines.en: : That {i}does{/i} have a certain ring to it.
lines.zh: : 这名字听着{i}还挺{/i}顺口的。

lines.en: : Wailing Witch, Wakana Watabe sounds even better.
lines.zh: : 「哭泣女巫 Wakana Watabe」听起来更好。

lines.en: : How much thought have you put into this?
lines.zh: : 您在这上面花了多少心思？

lines.en: : What else am I supposed to think about while everyone has their noses buried in textbooks?
lines.zh: : 所有人的鼻子都埋在教科书里的时候，我还能想什么？

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. You don’t actually {i}teach{/i}, so that’s not a question you’d be able to answer.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。你其实根本不{i}教{/i}书，所以这个问题你答不上来。

lines.en: scene utawakana7
: Okay. Sensei, you and me are gonna go find the class-rep and have her show us how to do the thingamajig.
lines.zh: : 好的。Sensei，您和我现在就去找班长，让她教我们怎么弄那个叫什么来着的手续。

lines.en: : If I have to spend one more night in that dorm alone, I’m gonna flip.
lines.zh: : 要是再让我一个人在宿舍待一晚，我就要疯了。

lines.en: : That Molly girl stays up all hours of the night yelling about stuff and the hallway always smells like ramen.
lines.zh: : 那个叫 Molly 的女生整晚都在大吼大叫，走廊里永远一股拉面味。

lines.en: : I’m glad to see room-six has made that substantial of an impact.
lines.zh: : 很高兴看到六号房的影响力这么深远。

lines.en: : Also, why are there so many empty rooms up there? Why can’t we just move some of the other girls from downstairs up to that floor?
lines.zh: : 还有，楼上为什么那么多空房间？我们为什么不把楼下的一些女生搬到那层去？

lines.en: : Hey, I don’t make the rules.
lines.zh: : 嘿，规矩又不是我定的。

lines.en: : You don’t enforce them, either, apparently.
lines.zh: : 显然，你也不执行规矩。

lines.en: : Physical contact between teachers and students is prohibited...and this girl {i}still{/i} has her hand on me for some reason.
lines.zh: : 教师与学生之间的身体接触是被禁止的……而这个女生不知为何{i}还{/i}把手放在我身上。

lines.en: The first part of that sentence started to make me a little worried, but I’m glad it was just more of Wakana being self-centered.
lines.zh: 那句话的前半段让我有点担心，不过还好，后半段只是 Wakana 又在以自我为中心。

lines.en: : You want me to let go? Fine! I’ve got stuff to do anyway!
lines.zh: : 你想让我松手？行！反正我还有事要做！

lines.en: : Class-A rules! Class-B is dumb! And Sensei would totally beat you in a fight!
lines.zh: : A 班最棒！B 班最蠢！而且 Sensei 打架绝对打得过你！

lines.en: : All I wanted was to eat my bento...why does this cursed building always torment me so?
lines.zh: : 我只是想安安静静吃个便当……为什么这栋被诅咒的楼总要这么折磨我？

lines.en: scene black
Uta removes her hand from Ms. Watabe’s dress and decides to grab me instead, pulling me down the hall on the way to the...
lines.zh: Uta 把手从 Watabe 老师的裙子上收了回来，转而抓住我，拉着我就往走廊那头走，去……

lines.en: : Wait, where are we even going?
lines.zh: : 等等，我们到底要去哪儿？

lines.en: : The classroom!
lines.zh: : 教室！

lines.en: : It’s lunch-time. Makoto is probably in the cafeteria with Miku right now.
lines.zh: : 现在是午休。Makoto 大概正和 Miku 在食堂。

lines.en: : Or the roof, maybe? I don’t really know where she spends her lunches, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 也可能在天台？说实话，我真不知道她午休都在哪儿过。

lines.en: : Well then...I’ll go check the cafeteria and you go check the roof! I don’t think I’m allowed up there anyway.
lines.zh: : 那这样……我去食堂找，您去天台找！反正我大概也不准上去。

lines.en: : Neither am I, I don’t think. But that’s never really stopped me before.
lines.zh: : 我想我也不准。不过这从来没真的拦住过我。

lines.en: Uta and I break apart, heading in separate directions.
lines.zh: 我和 Uta 分开，各走各的路。

lines.en: Just when I round the corner to head for the stairs, though, {i}fate{/i} (If it even exists) does something interesting.
lines.zh: 可就在我拐过弯准备上楼梯时，{i}命运{/i}（如果它真的存在的话）做了件有意思的事。

lines.en: scene utawakana8
I find Io standing at the window, overlooking a sudden half-blizzard busy dusting tables and benches with snow.
lines.zh: 我发现 Io 站在窗边，望着一场突如其来的半吊子暴风雪，正忙着给桌子和长椅铺上一层雪。

lines.en: She looks quite...despondent compared to how she was at the bathhouse.
lines.zh: 和在澡堂时相比，她看起来……相当沮丧。

lines.en: Could this be the result of those [high_school] woes I’ve so commonly started citing despite not remembering how things even were for me back then?
lines.zh: 难道这就是我经常挂在嘴边的那种[high_school]烦恼？尽管我根本不记得自己当年是什么样。

lines.en: I guess.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: But I still don’t know much about Io.
lines.zh: 但我对 Io 还是了解得太少。

lines.en: Hell, for all I know, someone she loves could have just died- and reaching out to her about why she’s just standing around instead of eating would do more harm than good.
lines.zh: 见鬼，说不定她深爱的人刚刚死了——这时候去问她为什么不去吃饭而是站在这儿，可能只会适得其反。

lines.en: Or maybe she’s not hungry?
lines.zh: 或者她只是不饿？

lines.en: From this angle, it’s easy to tell just how skinny she is.
lines.zh: 从这个角度看，很容易看出她有多瘦。

lines.en: Do skinny people even get hungry?
lines.zh: 瘦子也会饿吗？

lines.en: I flood my mind with any stray thought I can think of to distract me from speaking up and grabbing her attention.
lines.zh: 我拼命往脑子里塞各种乱七八糟的念头，好让自己不开口、不引起她的注意。

lines.en: Maybe it’s because I hate helping people?
lines.zh: 也许是因为我讨厌帮助别人？

lines.en: Or-
lines.zh: 或者——

lines.en: Maybe it’s because she looks beautiful enough in this moment that it would be a sin to disturb her?
lines.zh: 也许是因为她此刻美到让人不忍心打扰？

lines.en: scene utawakana9
Damn.
lines.zh: 糟了。

lines.en: She found me.
lines.zh: 她发现我了。

lines.en: : Hey.
: Hey.
: You’re not planning on asking me why I’m up here instead of in the cafeteria or anything, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会打算问我为什么在这儿而不是在食堂之类的吧？

lines.en: : Not anymore, I'm not.
lines.zh: : 现在不打算了。

lines.en: : I was leaning toward you not being hungry, in case you were wondering.
lines.zh: : 你要是想知道的话，我刚才倾向于认为你是不饿。

lines.en: : Leaning toward?
lines.zh: : 倾向于？

lines.en: : What other possibilities did you come up with while you were staring at me?
lines.zh: : 你盯着我看的时候，还想出了别的什么可能？

lines.en: : The only other notable one was that a loved one died.
lines.zh: : 唯一值得一提的另一个可能是，你深爱的人死了。

lines.en: : Wow, straight to the dark stuff.
lines.zh: : 哇，直接就往阴暗面猜啊。

lines.en: : So, which one’s right? Lack of hunger or abundance of grief?
lines.zh: : 那么，哪个对了？是不饿，还是悲伤过剩？

lines.en: scene utawakana10
: Lack of hunger is closer, but it’s more of a mix of things.
lines.zh: : 不饿更接近一点，不过更像是各种事混在一起。

lines.en: scene utawakana11
: Where’s Uta?
lines.zh: : Uta 呢？

lines.en: : Looking for the class-rep so she can start the process of getting you on our team.
lines.zh: : 去找班长了，好启动把你拉进我们队的流程。

lines.en: : Figures. She hasn’t shut up about it ever since dragging you to the bathhouse the other day.
lines.zh: : 果然。自从那天把你拽去澡堂之后，她就没闭过嘴。

lines.en: : Are you still excited?
lines.zh: : 你还兴奋吗？

lines.en: : A little.
lines.zh: : 有一点。

lines.en: : The initial excitement wore off when I realized I’d still be surrounded by a bunch of other people I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 等我意识到周围还是一堆不认识的人，最初那股兴奋就消退了。

lines.en: : But at least Uta will be there.
lines.zh: : 但至少 Uta 会在。

lines.en: : Oh, and you seem cool, too. So we can be friends if you want.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有你看起来也挺酷。所以你想的话我们可以做朋友。

lines.en: : That discount I brought up the other day is still on the table as well.
lines.zh: : 上次我提的那个折扣也还算数。

lines.en: : And the offer to peek on Uta?
lines.zh: : 那偷看 Uta 的提议呢？

lines.en: scene utawakana12
: Coincidentally, I just-so-happen to eat dinner around the time she comes over to bathe, so I’d never really know to begin with.
lines.zh: : 巧了，我吃晚饭的时间刚好就是她过来泡澡的时间，所以我从一开始就不会知道。

lines.en: : You are way cooler with the prospect of an older man perving out on your best friend than you should be.
lines.zh: : 你对自己最好的朋友被一个老男人偷窥这件事，淡定得有点过头了。

lines.en: : It’s more that I just...don't care.
lines.zh: : 不如说我只是一点都不在乎。

lines.en: : As long as you know you’re literally enabling me by giving away all this info.
lines.zh: : 只要你知道，把这些消息都透露给我，等于是在纵容我。

lines.en: scene utawakana13
: You’re right. I’m a bad friend.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我是个糟糕的朋友。

lines.en: : I should get better at hiding certain things.
lines.zh: : 我该学着把某些事藏好一点。

lines.en: : But hiding things takes so much effort.
lines.zh: : 但藏事实在太费劲了。

lines.en: : Like, I’m sure you have plenty of stuff you wish you could just tell everybody, right?
lines.zh: : 比如说，你肯定也有不少想干脆告诉所有人的事吧？

lines.en: : Stuff that eats away at you. Changes your perspective. Keeps you awake at night.
lines.zh: : 那些一点点啃噬你的事。改变你看法的事。让你夜里睡不着的事。

lines.en: : Ruins your life, even.
lines.zh: : 甚至毁掉你人生的事。

lines.en: : Do you have anything like that?
lines.zh: : 你有这种事吗？

lines.en: : Or would even admitting that without providing any details be too much of a secret for you to give away?
lines.zh: : 还是说，光是承认有这么回事、却不透露任何细节，就已经是你给不起的秘密了？

lines.en: If anything, I have too many secrets.
lines.zh: 要说的话，我的秘密太多了。

lines.en: But I don’t think there’s anything I’m...tired of concealing.
lines.zh: 但我觉得并没有什么……是我藏累了。

lines.en: I’d actually go as far as saying it would be even more tiring to reveal all of those ideas or happenings I’ve tucked away somewhere.
lines.zh: 我甚至可以说，把那些我藏在某处的想法和往事全说出来，反而更累。

lines.en: Io is just different, apparently. And that’s fine.
lines.zh: 显然 Io 只是不一样。这也挺好。

lines.en: I can’t imagine her secrets are in the same boat as mine anyway.
lines.zh: 反正我也想象不出她的秘密能和我的相提并论。

lines.en: : I’m not really sure what to say to that.
lines.zh: : 我真不知道该怎么回应。

lines.en: : It was mostly rhetorical anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正那多半也只是随口一问。

lines.en: : You seem a little different when you’re alone.
lines.zh: : 你一个人的时候看起来有点不一样。

lines.en: : Is that a bad thing?
lines.zh: : 这是坏事吗？

lines.en: : Not necessarily. Especially considering you really only have Uta now.
lines.zh: : 不一定是。尤其是考虑到你现在其实只有 Uta 一个人。

lines.en: : Not just {i}now{/i}. I only had Uta in my other[school], too.
lines.zh: : 不只是{i}现在{/i}。在原来那所[school]里，我也只有 Uta。

lines.en: : But that’s a calculated move on my part.
lines.zh: : 但那是我有意为之。

lines.en: : I’m sure I could make friends if I truly wanted to.
lines.zh: : 我相信只要我真想交，还是交得到朋友的。

lines.en: : And here I was thinking you were some sort of outcast who was just feeling lonely without knowing anyone in a new environment.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你是那种被孤立的人，只是因为在新环境里谁都不认识才觉得孤独。

lines.en: : Something like that would be a lot simpler.
lines.zh: : 要是那样的话倒简单多了。

lines.en: : Instead, I put on my uniform every morning...pull up my stockings...and proceed to mislead everyone about the person I really am for the next seven hours or so.
lines.zh: : 实际上，我每天早上穿上制服……拉好长筒袜……然后在接下来的七个小时里，让所有人都误以为我是另一个人。

lines.en: : But, like I was saying, keeping secrets is tiring. And seven hours is a long time.
lines.zh: : 不过就像我说的，保守秘密很累。而七个小时是很长的时间。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how many secrets [teenage]girls have?
lines.zh: : 你知道[teenage]女生有多少秘密吗？

lines.en: : Even stuff that isn’t a secret becomes a secret with them.
lines.zh: : 在她们那儿，连根本不算秘密的事都会变成秘密。

lines.en: : And before you know it, you’ve got an entire archive of things you can’t reveal to specific subsets of girls or cliques or blah-blah-blah.
lines.zh: : 不知不觉间，你就攒下了一整套档案，里面全是不能对某一小撮女生、某个小圈子之类的说的事。

lines.en: scene utawakana14
: Frankly, I hate it.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我讨厌这样。

lines.en: : One of the reasons I like Uta so much is that she doesn’t really have any secrets.
lines.zh: : 我这么喜欢 Uta，其中一个原因就是她其实没有任何秘密。

lines.en: : She’s the kind of girl that just reveals everything about herself instinctively, so there’s nothing I need to worry about accidentally letting slip.
lines.zh: : 她是那种会本能地把自己的一切都抖出来的女生，所以我完全不用担心自己不小心说漏嘴。

lines.en: : ...Why are you telling me all this?
lines.zh: : ……你为什么跟我说这些？

lines.en: : Where is this coming from?
lines.zh: : 这都是从哪儿冒出来的？

lines.en: scene utawakana15
: Huh? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 啊？什么意思？

lines.en: : I’m just confused as to why you’re suddenly opening up to me despite making it sound like the only relationship you need is the one you have with Uta.
lines.zh: : 我只是不明白，你说得好像只要有 Uta 就够了，却又突然对我掏心掏肺。

lines.en: scene utawakana16
: Oh. Okay. I get what you mean.
lines.zh: : 哦。好吧。我懂你意思了。

lines.en: : Yeah, it probably feels a little weird hearing all of that when you just showed up at this window by chance today.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你今天只是碰巧走到这扇窗前，就听了这么一大堆，确实有点怪。

lines.en: : Uta’s not the only person I need.
lines.zh: : Uta 不是我唯一需要的人。

lines.en: : I need all kinds of people and all kinds of things.
lines.zh: : 我需要各种各样的人，也需要各种各样的事。

lines.en: : I’m incredibly high maintenance in the lowest maintenance way possible.
lines.zh: : 我是个极难伺候的人，却用着最不麻烦人的方式。

lines.en: : But, you see-
lines.zh: : 但是，你看——

lines.en: : Right now-
lines.zh: : 现在——

lines.en: scene utawakana17
: Right now-
lines.zh: : 现在——

lines.en: : I kind of just want somebody to watch the snow with.
lines.zh: : 我有点只是想找个人一起看雪。

lines.en: : I can’t guarantee you’ll like getting to know me or that I’ll like getting to know you.
lines.zh: : 我不能保证你会喜欢认识我，也不能保证我会喜欢认识你。

lines.en: : But, for some strange reason-
lines.zh: : 但是，出于某种奇怪的原因——

lines.en: : It's harder to erect walls when you're around.
lines.zh: : 你在的时候，我很难把墙筑起来。

lines.en: scene utawakana18
: Heh...
: Saying “erect” made me think of your penis again.
lines.zh: : 一说「竖起来」，我又想起您的阴茎了。

lines.en: : Oh, come on!
lines.zh: : 哦，不是吧！

lines.en: : I leave for ten minutes and you guys are already talking about weird stuff! Jeez!
lines.zh: : 我才走了十分钟，你们就开始聊这些乱七八糟的！天哪！

lines.en: scene utawakana19
: Oh, Uta.
lines.zh: : 哦，Uta。

lines.en: : That was all me. I was just making a joke.
lines.zh: : 那全是我说的。我只是开个玩笑。

lines.en: : Whatever it was, I wanted to let you know, Sensei, that Makoto’s going to handle the paperwork now that we have Ms. Watabe’s approval.
lines.zh: : 不管那是什么，我想告诉您，Sensei，既然有了 Watabe 老师的同意，Makoto 会去处理文件的。

lines.en: : She says Io should be able to join the class tomorrow as long as the principal is okay with it.
lines.zh: : 她说只要校长点头，Io 明天就能进班。

lines.en: scene utawakana20
: That's good news.
lines.zh: : 这可是好消息。

lines.en: : I guess we’ll be able to watch the snow fall together after all, huh?
lines.zh: : 看来我们终究还是能一起看雪了，对吧？

lines.en: : Thanks again for taking a chance on me.
lines.zh: : 再次谢谢您愿意在我身上赌一把。

lines.en: : I’m sure I came across a little weird today, so I’ll try not to be as...{i}me{/i} as possible tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 我今天肯定显得有点怪，所以明天我尽量不那么……像{i}我自己{/i}。

lines.en: : No promises, though.
lines.zh: : 不过不做保证。

lines.en: : What is it with all this heckin’ flirting today? I’m the one who did all the work and nobody is flirting with me.
lines.zh: : 今天怎么全在打情骂俏啊？活儿都是我干的，结果没人来撩我。

lines.en: scene utawakana21
: There, there. Good girl, Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : 好了好了。乖孩子，Uta。

lines.en: : You did well.
lines.zh: : 你做得很好。

lines.en: : I will not...be swayed...by something as trivial as...my head...being rubbed!
lines.zh: : 我不会……被区区……摸头……这种小事……动摇的！

lines.en: : Even if it feels really good...
lines.zh: : 就算真的好舒服……

lines.en: scene black
The three of us walk to the cafeteria together and, by the time we get there, the lunch period is already about to come to a close.
lines.zh: 我们三个人一起走向食堂，等到了那儿，午休时间已经快结束。

lines.en: I try to break apart, but they reel me back in and I get coaxed into buying the two of them drinks.
lines.zh: 我本想脱身，却被她们拽了回来，还被哄着给她们俩买了饮料。

lines.en: It’s funny.
lines.zh: 挺好笑的。

lines.en: I started this period with the full intention of taking money {i}from{/i} others and wound up spending money {i}on{/i} others instead.
lines.zh: 这一节课间我开始时满心想着{i}从{/i}别人那儿拿钱，结果反倒是在别人{i}身上{/i}花了钱。

lines.en: I guess even I can have good moments every once in a while.
lines.zh: 看来我偶尔也能有点好时候。

lines.en: I wonder, though-
lines.zh: 不过我在想——

lines.en: What did Io mean by “High maintenance in the lowest maintenance way possible?”
lines.zh: Io 说的「用最不麻烦人的方式维持极高的维护成本」到底是什么意思？

lines.en: That’s a strange thing to say.
lines.zh: 这话说得挺奇怪的。

lines.en: Granted, a lot of what she said today didn’t exactly click with me.
lines.zh: 诚然，她今天说的很多话我都没太听懂。

lines.en: But I can’t imagine she’s even half as complex as someone like Maya and I’ve been dealing with her pretty...adequately, I guess.
lines.zh: 但我想她再复杂也复杂不过 Maya 的一半，而我和 Maya 相处得……还算过得去吧。

lines.en: I’ll just have to wait and see what that’s all about.
lines.zh: 这到底是怎么回事，我只能等着看了。

lines.en: There’s no other way around it.
lines.zh: 没有别的办法。

lines.en: I’m sure it’ll make a little more sense the more time I spend with her, though...
lines.zh: 不过我相信，跟她相处越久，就会越明白一点……
